scenes.text: Welcome to Claude Skills, by Curiously.
We gave Claude a vague job: add discount codes to a cart.
Plain Claude just started. Fifteen new lines, built on rules it guessed, and it only told us after.
With the file, it wrote nothing, in our test. It asked six questions first, like before tax or after?
That's rule one: think before coding. The other three: keep it simple, change only what you must, and work toward a goal you can check. Each one comes from his post.
The catch: Karpathy didn't write it. A developer built it from his post. No updates since April, and no licence file, though it says MIT.
